description: This Java source file defines the 'EntityExpr' class, which represents an infix condition expression in the Apache OFBiz entity framework. It includes constructors, accessors, validation, and string generation for SQL queries, as well as methods for condition matching and type checking.

classes.name: EntityExpr
classes.description: Represents an infix condition expression used in entity queries within the OFBiz framework. Provides methods for constructing, validating, and rendering SQL conditions, as well as for matching and checking condition types.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for creating an infix comparison expression with specified left operand, operator, and right operand.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for combining two EntityCondition objects with a logical operator.

methods.name: getLhs
methods.description: Retrieves the left-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Retrieves the operator used in the expression.

methods.name: getRhs
methods.description: Retrieves the right-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the operator's condition evaluates to empty.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL where clause string for the expression based on the entity model and datasource.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a given map of values.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the entity model.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of the condition.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the condition.

methods.name: checkRhsType
methods.description: Validates that the right-hand side value's type matches the expected entity field type.
